caseName: Reed v. Director General of Railroads
caseNameFull: Gertrude M. Reed, Administratrix, etc. v. Director General of Railroads, United States Railroad Administration, operating Philadelphia & Reading Railroad

opinions.text: October 11, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of the State of Pennsylvania granted. Mr. Frederick S. Tyler for petitioner. Mr. William Clarke Mason for respondent.
